title: Order lines without double counting
prompt: The sales report lists every order line with its product name, and its line count must match `order_items` exactly. Write `solve(order_items, products)` so it returns `order_id`, `line_no`, `product_id` and `name`.
rules: The product list sometimes arrives with a product row repeated. Repeated product rows are exact copies.
Every row of `order_items` appears exactly as many times as it does in `order_items`, no more and no fewer. A line whose product isn't in `products` keeps a missing `name`.
Return only these four columns, in this order.
hints: Repeated product rows multiply the lines that match them. Fix the side that has the problem.
`products.dropDuplicates()` removes exact copies. Do it before the join, not after.
Which join type keeps a line whose product is missing from `products`?
